desc:
🥚 Welcome to Jump for SCP! 

How to Play:
💪 Train your legs to increase your Jump Power
⬆️ Jump higher to reach new areas
🥚 Steal SCP eggs! guarded by giant SCP
🏃 Escape and bring the SCP eggs! back to your plot
🐣 Hatch SCP eggs! to discover rare SCP
💰 Earn money from your SCP—even while offline
🏋️ Upgrade your barbells, trails, and speed coils
✨ Discover rare sizes, Mythic SCP eggs!, and secret SCP
📖 Complete your SCP Index and claim rewards

How high can you jump, and can you collect them all?

👍 Like the game and join the group for rewards and future updates!

🎮 Supports Desktop, Console, Mobile, and Tablet players.
